edges.reason: msg.sender is recorded as the new highest bidder inside bid.
Caller-controlled bidder address receives an external ETH refund transfer.
msg.sender is the caller credited in the Collect event and its listings are cleaned.
msg.sender is the buyer receiving the NFT in buy.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which validates msg.sender against _owner.
isOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner address.
putOnSale is gated by tokenOwnerOnlly which compares IMintableToken.ownerOf to msg.sender.
withdrawERC20 is restricted to the owner identified by msg.sender.
block.timestamp is used as auction startingTime and as the guard for re-listing an expired auction.
closingTime is derived from block.timestamp plus the user supplied duration.
collect requires block.timestamp > closingTime before settlement.
updatePrice requires block.timestamp < closingTime for bid-type auctions.
activeAuction modifier gates bid on block.timestamp versus closingTime.
bid writes the updated auction struct back into the auctions mapping.
collect deletes the settled auction entry from the auctions mapping.
collect removes the token from the global tokensForSale list.
collect accrues broker fees into brokerageBalance.
collect clears the tokenOpenForSale flag after settlement.
buy deletes the auction entry for the purchased token.
buy accrues broker fees into brokerageBalance.
buy clears the tokenOpenForSale flag.
putOnSale writes the newly constructed auction struct into auctions.
putOnSale marks the token as open for sale.
putOnSale appends the token to the global tokensForSale list.
putOnSale appends the token to the caller's per-user listing list.
putOnSale adds flat-price tokens to fixedPriceTokens.
putOnSale adds bid-only tokens to auctionTokens.
updatePrice rewrites the auction price fields in the auctions mapping.
putSaleOff deletes the auction entry.
putSaleOff removes the token from the global listing list.
putSaleOff clears the tokenOpenForSale flag.
putSaleOff removes flat-price tokens from fixedPriceTokens.
putSaleOff removes auction tokens from auctionTokens.
setBrokerage, restricted by onlyOwner, writes the fee used in all payout math.
Constructor sets the initial brokerage value.
Constructor calls transferOwnership setting _owner to the deployer.
transferOwnership, restricted by onlyOwner, mutates _owner.
addERC20TokenPayment appends to the ERC20 whitelist array.
removeERC20TokenPayment deletes entries from the ERC20 whitelist array.
bid performs an external ETH refund before finalizing auction state.
bid calls transferFrom on a caller supplied ERC20 contract.
bid performs an external NFT safeTransferFrom with a receiver callback.
collect transfers ETH/ERC20 to creator and owner before cleaning listings.
collect performs an external NFT safeTransferFrom to the bidder.
collect computes payouts through unchecked multiplication and subtraction on currentBid.
buy transfers ETH to creator and previous owner before clearing state.
buy calls transferFrom on a listing supplied ERC20 contract.
buy performs an external NFT safeTransferFrom to the buyer.
buy computes fee splits using unchecked arithmetic on buyPrice.
withdraw pushes the full ETH brokerage balance to the owner.
withdraw reads and then zeroes the ETH brokerage balance entry.
withdrawERC20 performs an external ERC20 transfer on a whitelisted token.
withdrawERC20 reads and then zeroes the token brokerage balance entry.
putOnSale computes closingTime from an unbounded user supplied duration.
tokenID parameter indexes the auction and token state in bid.
_mintableToken parameter selects the external NFT contract used by bid.
amount parameter is compared to currentBid and transferred in bid.
tokenID parameter selects the auction to settle in collect.
_mintableToken parameter selects the external NFT contract used by collect.
tokenID parameter selects the listing to purchase in buy.
_mintableToken parameter selects the external NFT contract used by buy.
_tokenID parameter keys the new auction and listing arrays in putOnSale.
_startingPrice parameter becomes the auction currentBid.
_auctionType parameter branches between flat price and auction listings.
_buyPrice parameter sets the flat purchase price in the new auction struct.
_duration parameter directly determines the closing time arithmetic.
_mintableToken parameter selects the NFT contract validated in putOnSale.
_erc20Token parameter is whitelist-checked and stored as the payment token.
tokenID parameter selects the listing to modify in updatePrice.
_mintableToken parameter selects the auction mapping entry in updatePrice.
_newPrice parameter overwrites buyPrice or startingPrice.
_erc20Token parameter is whitelist-checked and stored on the listing.
tokenID parameter selects the listing to remove in putSaleOff.
_mintableToken parameter selects the auction mapping entry in putSaleOff.
_erc20Token parameter is whitelist-checked and used for the payout transfer.
Local memory auction copy in bid is read from and written back to the auctions mapping.
The stale memory copy's currentBid feeds the external refund transfer in bid.
Local auction copy in collect is loaded from the auctions mapping.
The memory copy's currentBid determines the external payout amounts in collect.
royality local feeds the subtraction-based payout computation in collect.
brokerageAmount local feeds the subtraction-based payout computation in collect.
Local auction copy in buy is loaded from the auctions mapping.
The memory copy's buyPrice determines external ETH payouts in buy.
lastOwner_funds is produced by unchecked subtraction in buy.
